test_title: RRB ALP CBT-II (Fitter) Official Paper (Held On: 02 May, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
In a certain code language,

'A × B' means 'A is the son of B',

'A - B' means 'A is the brother of B',

'A + B' means 'A is the wife of B', and

'A % B' means 'A is the father of B'.

If 'M × N − P % S + T', then how is M related to T?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b1887e263a0be106c3fc3bef05d4c58742c6a15e36b93bc74e9b8034e1f5d249.png] 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2b1b09affccba1eb7e68773889c21e4be0815c027c01e38f51c65006cdec8fb9.png] 

 
 

 Code Language (A is of B)
 
 

 Symbol
 ×
 -
 +
 %
 
 

 Meaning
 Son
 Brother
 Wife
 Father
 
 

 

Given Expression: M × N − P % S + T

S + T: S is the wife of T. 

P % S: P is the father of S. 

N − P: N is the brother of P. 

M × N: M is the son of N. 

Family Tree Representation:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b1306e1f4439489f3991fed80bca70e8ef3d6c42fa7f3486792930bd9e987147.png] 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2548eeade212601aa64846059b1a6a76852819cc3d286a8d80b3c5a2d6523d25.png] 

Therefore, M is the Wife's father's brother's son of T.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 1".**
